scope: 3010 unordered radix partitions of 27, original prime m2 natural input, identical candidate interval and point base

layout.prepared/index.json: Complete ordered input partition list, source validation and original input/source/base hashes; no measured Hilbert data
layout.census/input.json,system.sing: Byte-identical original input and original all-binary source
layout.census/binding.json: Full original source validation, base manifest identity and Lucas primality certificate
layout.census/cases/NNNN.json: One partition's radices, weights, domain bijection and compact equation presentation; exact arrays or explicitly bounded result
layout.census/summary.json: Complete per-partition index, hashes and exact/lower-bound fields
layout.census/manifest.json: Path, byte length and SHA256 of all native payloads except this manifest
layout.protocol.json,host.txt: Frozen contract and diagnostic host metadata

degree_convention: First zero Hilbert coefficient of this m2 highest-form quotient, not affine FFD/LFD or solving degree
exact_status: exact_hilbert_under_large_characteristic_theorem: socle<=40, complete block Hilbert/rank and tensor quotient arrays retained
bounded_status: rigorous_lower_bound_only: nonzero bidegree(socle,1) implies first vanishing>=socle+2; exact degree remains null
numeric_encoding: Dimensions and Hilbert coefficients are exact JSON integers within u64; large field values, coordinate weights and candidate counts are decimal strings
source_semantics: The original source is unchanged. Candidate equations are specified compactly by the per-digit product ranges and coordinate weights; expanded high-degree sources are not claimed to be materialized.
replay: prime_radix_census verify OUTPUT recomputes every candidate and compares all native payload bytes. Frozen controller separately binds input index and instrument hashes.
publication_rule: Partial directories and failed attempts remain preserved. A complete census requires all3010 records and successful native replay. No timing comparison.
